categories.main_business_segments: Envipro Holdings operates primarily in three business segments: Resource Circulation (recycling of metals, plastics, and rubber), Global Trading (domestic and international trading of recycled resources and logistics services), and Lithium-ion Battery Recycling (recovery of rare metals from used batteries). The company also provides environmental management consulting and disability welfare services as additional businesses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced physical sorting equipment, recycling engineering expertise, and integrated processes including collection, transport, shearing, dismantling, crushing, sorting, compression, and solidification. For lithium-ion battery recycling, it uses drying, crushing, and separation technologies to extract black mass containing rare metals. The group emphasizes traceability and quality control throughout the recycling chain.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include electric furnace and blast furnace steelmakers, non-ferrous metal traders and refiners, paper manufacturers, plastic and rubber product manufacturers, biomass power plants, and trading companies. The company also serves municipalities, factories, demolition sites, and general consumers, with a significant portion of sales to major domestic and overseas steelmakers.
categories.geographic_coverage: Envipro Holdings operates mainly in Japan, with a network of collection and processing sites nationwide. Internationally, it has trading and sales activities in Asia (notably Vietnam), Europe (UK and Netherlands), and South America (Chile), with exports to various global markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned downstream in the supply chain, focusing on the collection, intermediate processing, and recycling of waste materials into reusable resources, and then supplying these recycled materials to manufacturers and trading companies. It also acts as a logistics and trading intermediary for recycled resources.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include leading the circular economy (CE), supporting both manufacturing and regional resource cycles, and transforming into a green materials manufacturer. R&D focuses on advanced recycling technologies for difficult-to-recycle materials (e.g., incineration ash, lithium-ion batteries, polymers), process automation, data utilization, and decarbonization. The company is also investing in human capital, governance, and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from the sale of recycled materials (metals, plastics, rubber, black mass), trading commissions, logistics services, and consulting fees. The company recognizes revenue at the point of delivery or acceptance, depending on contract terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The industry is fragmented, with many regional SMEs and no dominant nationwide player. Envipro Holdings differentiates itself through its scale, integrated service offering, advanced technology, and nationwide/overseas network. It faces competition from both domestic recyclers and potential new entrants, including foreign and cross-industry companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending June 2025, consolidated sales were approximately 49.1 billion yen, with operating profit of 972 million yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 1.18 billion yen. The company has over 630 employees and maintains a stable financial base, though recent years have seen revenue and profit fluctuations due to market conditions. The lithium-ion battery recycling segment is growing, while overall sales declined 6% year-on-year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Envipro Holdings emphasizes its ability to provide integrated, traceable, and high-quality recycling solutions from collection to material supply, supporting both industrial and regional circular economies. Its advanced sorting and recycling technologies, broad network, and expertise in difficult-to-recycle materials position it as a leader in sustainable resource management and green materials supply, contributing to decarbonization and ESG goals.
